content: धर {%a.%} (-रा, -री|{%f.%}) [धृ-अच्] (Usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Holding, carrying, bearing, wearing, containing, possessing, endowed with, preserving, observing, <ab>&c.</ab>; as in अक्षधर, अंशुधर, गदाधर, गङ्गाधर, महीधर, असृग्धर, दिव्याम्बरधर <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-रः@} .²1 A mountain; a hill-fort. शिवस्य यस्य हस्तेऽद्य धरौ सिंहपुरंदरौ <ls>Śiva B. 15. 17</ls>. उत्कं धरं द्रष्टुमवेक्ष्य शौरिमुत्कन्धरं दारुक इत्युवाच <ls>Śi. 4. 18</ls>; धरसंस्थः <ls>Ki. 15. 12</ls>. .²2 A flock of cotton. .²3 A frivolous or dissolute man (विट). .²4 The king of the tortoises, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} Viṣṇu in his Kūrma incarnation. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the Vasus. .²6 A sword. .{@-रम्@} poison.

धरा [धरति विश्वं धृ-अच्] .²1 The earth; धरा धारापातैर्मणिमयशरैर्भिद्यत इव <ls>Mk. 5. 22</ls>. .²2 A vein. .²3 Marrow. .²4 The womb or uterus. .²5 A mass of gold or other valuables given as a present to Brāhmaṇas. .²6 The ground, earth, land; ब्रह्मचारी धराशयः <ls>Ms. 6. 26</ls>.
